cards.text: Jesus just rebuked the winds and the sea, and it was perfectly calm (Matthew 8:26). Now He lands on the other side, in the region of the Gadarenes. And somebody meets Him there, friend, and it is NOT a welcome committee.

cards.question: Jesus lands in the region of the Gadarenes. Who comes to meet Him?
Where are these two demon-possessed men coming from?
The two demon-possessed men from the tombs are so ___ that no one can pass that way.

cards.text: He JUST got off the boat, and these two men are already SHOUTING at Him. Not even a "how was the trip?"

cards.question: True or false: The two men shouting at Jesus know who He is.

cards.text: They shout, "What do You want with us, Son of God?" I bet this is NOT the visitor they were hoping for.

cards.question: The two men shout a second question at Jesus. They ask if He has come here to…

answers.text: Torture them before the appointed time
Send them back across the sea
Bring the whole town against them

cards.text: In the distance, a large herd of pigs is feeding. So the demons beg Jesus, "If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs."

cards.question: True or false: Jesus answers the demons' request with a long speech.

cards.text: "Go!" He tells them, and they come out and go into the pigs. ONE word, friend, and they're GONE.
Then the whole herd takes off running. The pigs that were feeding are now moving like somebody yelled FREE COOKIES.

cards.question: Once the demons go into the pigs, where does the whole herd rush?

answers.text: Down the steep bank into the sea
Off the road and into the town
Back across the hills to the tombs

cards.text: The whole herd dies in the waters. Then those tending the pigs run off into the town, and I bet that report starts with, "So… you're gonna want to sit down."

cards.question: True or false: Those tending the pigs report only what happened to the herd.

cards.text: Then the WHOLE town goes out to meet Jesus. EVERYBODY. Friend, I didn't get that many visitors in all my years stuck in the back of a junk drawer.

cards.question: When the whole town sees Jesus, they beg Him to ___ their region.
